backends:
  deepseek:
    format: openai
    base_url: https://api.deepseek.com/v1
    auth:
      type: api_key
      value_env: DEEPSEEK_API_KEY
  mistral:
    format: openai
    base_url: https://api.mistral.ai/v1
    auth:
      type: api_key
      value_env: MISTRAL_API_KEY
  moonshot:
    format: openai
    base_url: https://api.moonshot.ai/v1
    auth:
      type: api_key
      value_env: MOONSHOT_API_KEY
  zai:
    format: openai
    base_url: https://api.z.ai/api/paas/v4
    auth:
      type: api_key
      value_env: ZAI_API_KEY
  minimax:
    format: openai
    base_url: https://api.minimax.io/v1
    auth:
      type: api_key
      value_env: MINIMAX_API_KEY
  openrouter-free:
    enabled: ${MERITORDER_ALLOW_FREE_MODELS:-false}
    format: openai
    base_url: https://openrouter.ai/api/v1
    auth:
      type: api_key
      value_env: OPENROUTER_API_KEY
  anthropic:
    format: anthropic
    base_url: https://api.anthropic.com
    cache_ttl_seconds: 3600
    auth:
      type: api_key
      header: x-api-key
      value_env: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
  bedrock:
    enabled: ${MERITORDER_BEDROCK:-true}
    format: anthropic
    base_url: https://bedrock-mantle.${AWS_REGION:-us-east-1}.api.aws/anthropic
    anthropic_version: '2026-10-21'
    forward_anthropic_beta: false
    cache_ttl_seconds: 3600
    auth:
      type: aws_sigv4
      service: bedrock-mantle
      region: ${AWS_REGION:-us-east-1}
      profile: ${AWS_PROFILE:-}
  foundry-claude:
    enabled: ${MERITORDER_FOUNDRY_CLAUDE:-true}
    format: anthropic
    base_url: ${AZURE_FOUNDRY_ENDPOINT}/anthropic
    forward_anthropic_beta: false
    cache_ttl_seconds: 3600
    auth:
      type: api_key
      header: x-api-key
      value_env: AZURE_FOUNDRY_API_KEY
  vertex:
    enabled: ${MERITORDER_VERTEX:-true}
    format: anthropic
    flavor: vertex
    project: ${GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT}
    region: global
    cache_ttl_seconds: 3600
    auth:
      type: google
  vertex-gemini:
    enabled: ${MERITORDER_VERTEX:-true}
    format: openai
    base_url: https://aiplatform.googleapis.com/v1/projects/${GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT}/locations/global/endpoints/openapi
    auth:
      type: google
    effort_format: openai
    price_prefix: vertex_ai/
  vertex-gemini-native:
    enabled: ${MERITORDER_VERTEX_GEMINI_NATIVE:-false}
    format: openai
    api: gemini
    flavor: vertex
    project: ${GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT}
    region: global
    auth:
      type: google
  gemini:
    format: openai
    api: gemini
    base_url: https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta
    auth:
      type: api_key
      header: x-goog-api-key
      value_env: GEMINI_API_KEY
  azure-openai:
    format: openai
    base_url: ${AZURE_OPENAI_ENDPOINT}/openai/v1
    auth:
      type: api_key
      header: api-key
      value_env: AZURE_OPENAI_API_KEY
    max_tokens_field: max_completion_tokens
  openai:
    format: openai
    base_url: https://api.openai.com/v1
    auth:
      type: api_key
      value_env: OPENAI_API_KEY
    supports_prompt_cache_key: true
    max_tokens_field: max_completion_tokens
    api: responses
  xai:
    format: openai
    base_url: https://api.x.ai/v1
    auth:
      type: api_key
      value_env: XAI_API_KEY
  openrouter:
    format: openai
    base_url: https://openrouter.ai/api/v1
    auth:
      type: api_key
      value_env: OPENROUTER_API_KEY
  gpu-qwen-coder:
    enabled: ${MERITORDER_SKYPILOT:-false}
    kind: self_hosted
    format: openai
    gpu_cost_per_hour: 16.0
    capacity_tokens_per_second: 20000
    max_concurrency: 64
    cache_ttl_seconds: 600
    serve:
      provisioner: skypilot
      model: qwen3-coder-next
      accelerators: H100:4
      use_spot: true
      clouds:
      - aws
      - gcp
      - lambda
      image: vllm/vllm-openai:v0.32.0-cu129
      vllm_args: --max-model-len 262144
      max_replicas: 4
      scale_up_after_minutes: 10
      hold_minutes: 30
  gpu-small:
    enabled: ${MERITORDER_SKYPILOT_SMALL:-false}
    kind: self_hosted
    format: openai
    gpu_cost_per_hour: 1.29
    capacity_tokens_per_second: 1500
    max_concurrency: 32
    serve:
      provisioner: skypilot
      model: gpt-oss-20b
      accelerators: A10:1
      clouds:
      - lambda
      image: vllm/vllm-openai:v0.32.0-cu129
      vllm_args: --max-model-len 16384 --gpu-memory-utilization 0.92
      disk_size_gb: 256
      max_replicas: 1
  gpu-qwen-coder-k8s:
    enabled: ${MERITORDER_KUBERNETES:-false}
    kind: self_hosted
    format: openai
    gpu_cost_per_hour: 16.0
    capacity_tokens_per_second: 20000
    max_concurrency: 64
    cache_ttl_seconds: 600
    serve:
      provisioner: kubernetes
      model: qwen3-coder-next
      accelerators: H100:4
      image: vllm/vllm-openai:v0.32.0-cu129
      vllm_args: --max-model-len 262144
      max_replicas: 4
      kubernetes:
        api: kserve
        node_type: p5.48xlarge
        hf_token_secret: hf-token
        cpu: '32'
        memory: 256Gi

      type: google
    effort_format: openai
    price_prefix: vertex_ai/

    region: global
    auth:
      type: google

    format: openai
    api: gemini

      header: x-goog-api-key
      value_env: GEMINI_API_KEY

    format: openai
    base_url: ${AZURE_OPENAI_ENDPOINT}/openai/v1
    auth:
      type: api_key
      header: api-key
      value_env: AZURE_OPENAI_API_KEY
    max_tokens_field: max_completion_tokens
  openai:
    format: openai
    base_url: https://api.openai.com/v1
    auth:
      type: api_key
      value_env: OPENAI_API_KEY
    supports_prompt_cache_key: true
    max_tokens_field: max_completion_tokens
    api: responses
  xai:
    format: openai
    base_url: https://api.x.ai/v1
    auth:
      type: api_key
      value_env: XAI_API_KEY
  openrouter:
    format: openai
    base_url: https://openrouter.ai/api/v1
    auth:
      type: api_key
      value_env: OPENROUTER_API_KEY
  gpu-qwen-coder:
    enabled: ${MERITORDER_SKYPILOT:-false}
    kind: self_hosted
    format: openai
    gpu_cost_per_hour: 16.0
    capacity_tokens_per_second: 20000
    max_concurrency: 64
    cache_ttl_seconds: 600
    serve:
      provisioner: skypilot
      model: qwen3-coder-next
      accelerators: H100:4
      use_spot: true
      clouds:
      - aws
      - gcp
      - lambda
      image: vllm/vllm-openai:v0.32.0-cu129
      vllm_args: --max-model-len 262144
      max_replicas: 4
      scale_up_after_minutes: 10
      hold_minutes: 30
  gpu-small:
    enabled: ${MERITORDER_SKYPILOT_SMALL:-false}
    kind: self_hosted
    format: openai
    gpu_cost_per_hour: 1.29
    capacity_tokens_per_second: 1500
    max_concurrency: 32
    serve:
      provisioner: skypilot
      model: gpt-oss-20b

      clouds:
      - lambda
      image: vllm/vllm-openai:v0.32.0-cu129
      vllm_args: --max-model-len 16384 --gpu-memory-utilization 0.92

      max_replicas: 1

visible.files/docs/operations.md:
# Operating the nightly reconciliation

_Last reviewed: May 2024._

The scheduler runs `reconcile nightly --profile production` at 02:15 UTC.

## Bank feed outages

The bank feed times out now and then. The job retries a failed fetch 3 times with exponential
backoff (1 s, 2 s, 4 s): a fetch gives up after 4 attempts and about 7 seconds of waiting. When it
gives up, the run is marked `partial` and the on-call engineer gets a ticket.

## Ledger write failures

Writes to the ledger are retried by the database driver. If the report can't be stored, the job
exits non-zero and the scheduler retries the whole run once after 30 minutes.

"""Client for the bank's statement feed."""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import socket
import urllib.request
from datetime import date


class BankFeed:
    """Fetches statement lines from the feed.

    Each call makes exactly one HTTP request; retrying is up to the caller (the jobs wrap ``fetch_statement`` with a
    RetryPolicy). A request that takes longer than ``timeout`` seconds raises TimeoutError.
    """

    def __init__(self, url: str, timeout: float):
        self.url = url.rstrip("/")
        self.timeout = timeout

    def fetch_statement(self, day: date) -> list[dict]:
        try:
            with urllib.request.urlopen(f"{self.url}/statements/{day.isoformat()}", timeout=self.timeout) as r:
                return json.load(r)["lines"]
        except socket.timeout as e:
            raise TimeoutError(f"bank feed timed out after {self.timeout}s") from e

"""Backoff for the v1 importer."""


def backoff_delays(retries: int = 3, first: float = 1.0) -> list[float]:
    """1 s, 2 s, 4 s, ...: the wait doubles before each retry."""
    return [first * 2**i for i in range(retries)]

"""v1 importer: reads the bank's old CSV export."""

from __future__ import annotations

import csv
import io
import time

from .backoff import backoff_delays


def import_csv(read, retries: int = 3) -> list[dict]:
    """``read()`` returns the CSV text; it is retried on TimeoutError with backoff_delays()."""
    for delay in backoff_delays(retries):
        try:
            text = read()
            break
        except TimeoutError:
            time.sleep(delay)
    else:
        text = read()
    return [{"reference": row["ref"], "amount_cents": int(row["amount"])} for row in csv.DictReader(io.StringIO(text))]

# slotfinder

Finds free meeting slots in people's calendars. Times are minutes since midnight and every interval is
half-open, `[start, end)`: a meeting 09:00-10:00 and one 10:00-11:00 touch, with no gap between them.

```python
from slotfinder import Calendar

cal = Calendar()
cal.add("dana", "09:00-12:00", "all-hands")
cal.add("omar", "13:00-14:00", "planning")
cal.common_free(["dana", "omar"])   # [Interval(start=720, end=780), Interval(start=840, end=1020)]
```

Modules: `intervals` (the interval helpers everything else uses), `availability` (free slots in a working
day), `summary` (busy summaries for the weekly digest), `calendar`, `timefmt`.

Run the tests with `python -m unittest discover -s tests`.

"""Free time in a working day."""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Iterable

from .intervals import Interval, clip, merge

DAY_START = 9 * 60
DAY_END = 17 * 60


def free_slots(busy: Iterable[Interval], day_start: int = DAY_START, day_end: int = DAY_END,
               min_length: int = 30) -> list[Interval]:
    """The free time between day_start and day_end, given busy intervals.

    Busy intervals may overlap, touch, or reach outside the working day. Returns the gaps between busy time as sorted
    Intervals inside [day_start, day_end); gaps shorter than min_length minutes are left out.
    """
    free = []
    cursor = day_start
    for block in merge(clip(busy, day_start, day_end)):
        if block.start > cursor:
            free.append(Interval(cursor, block.start))
        cursor = block.end
    if cursor < day_end:
        free.append(Interval(cursor, day_end))
    return [slot for slot in free if slot.length >= min_length]

"""Busy summaries for the weekly digest."""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Iterable

from .intervals import Interval, merge, total


def busy_summary(busy: Iterable[Interval]) -> dict:
    """{"blocks": n, "busy_minutes": m, "longest_block": l} for one person's day.

    A block is a stretch of continuous busy time: meetings that overlap or follow each other with no gap form one block.
    busy_minutes counts each minute once; longest_block is the length of the longest block. All zero when nothing is
    busy.
    """
    busy = list(busy)
    blocks = merge(busy)
    return {"blocks": len(blocks), "busy_minutes": total(busy), "longest_block": max((b.length for b in blocks), default=0)}

"""Who gets paged."""

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import datetime

from .overrides import Override, on_call
from .rotation import Rotation


def escalation(rotation: Rotation, overrides: list[Override], ts: datetime) -> list[str]:
    """Who to page at ts, in order: whoever is on call (overrides included), then the backup.

    The backup is the member who has the next shift in the rotation; overrides don't change who that is. When the backup
    would be the person already paged first (a one-person rotation, or the next member covering this shift), the list
    has just one name.
    """
    primary = on_call(rotation, overrides, ts)
    backup = rotation.next_member(rotation.scheduled(ts))
    return [primary] if backup == primary else [primary, backup]
